Product Manager, Merchant Checkout
Tulip Commerce B.V. (fictional test company) · Amsterdam, Netherlands · Hybrid

Tulip Commerce builds checkout and billing tools for 25,000 online merchants across Europe. Our B2B SaaS platform processes card, iDEAL and wallet payments.

What you'll do
- Own the merchant checkout experience end to end, from payment methods to conversion.
- Work with a cross-functional team of 7 engineers, a designer and an analyst.
- Talk to merchants every week and turn what you learn into a clear roadmap.
- Use data and A/B testing to improve checkout conversion and payment success.

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of experience in product management, with at least 2 years in payments, checkout or billing.
- Experience with B2B SaaS products and merchants.
- Strong analytical skills; SQL is a plus.
- Excellent English. Dutch is a plus, not required.

What we offer
- Salary: €68,000 – €82,000 per year, plus 8% holiday allowance.
- We are an IND recognised sponsor and offer visa sponsorship (highly skilled migrant) and relocation support.
- 30% ruling for eligible candidates.
- 27 vacation days.
